What does it cost to install carpet in Everett, WA?

Plan on $4 to $7 per square foot installed in Everett, covering carpet, pad, labor, new tack strip and haul-away. Most projects come in between $2,000 and $4,500, while a 1,200 sq ft main floor with a staircase typically runs $5,500 to $8,500. The carpet grade you choose moves the total more than anything else — and you choose it from full-size samples in your own house.
Does the mobile carpet showroom really come to Everett homes?

It does — anywhere in Everett, Riverside to Silver Lake. The van carries 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades. We set them down in the rooms they'd cover so the colors read true in your own light, measure every room and stair, and write up your price during the same visit. The trip is free, and evening slots are there for shift schedules.
What does carpet stretching cost in Everett?

Stretching starts at $99 per room in Everett. A power stretcher pulls buckles, waves and trip hazards back out for roughly a fifth of what new carpet would cost, which makes it the right call whenever the pile still stands up and you can still live with the color.
What do carpeted stairs cost in Everett?

Stair work starts at $18 per step, in waterfall or cap-and-band style. Everett's older two-stories and split-entries often add landings and pie-shaped winders — we count those in the written quote from the start, so nothing shows up later as an extra line.
How long does a carpet install take in an Everett home?

One working day covers most Everett homes. Three or four bedrooms plus a staircase is a normal day for the crew; a whole house with heavy furniture can spill into a second day. The schedule goes on your written quote, and we can time the job around a shift rotation or a rental turnover date.
Will you move the furniture, or is that on me?

We handle the big pieces — beds, dressers, sofas and tables come out and go back where they belong, included on most jobs. What we ask of you is the small stuff: empty the closet floors, unplug electronics, and set aside anything fragile you'd rather carry yourself.
Is it worth stretching my carpet, or should I replace it?

Stretch when the pile still springs back, the backing is sound and the color still works — that's a $99-per-room fix instead of a full replacement. Replace when traffic lanes are crushed flat, seams are letting go, the backing is breaking down, or pet odor has survived professional cleaning. We tell you which case you have before writing a quote.

All of them — Riverside, Delta, Bayside, Port Gardner, Rucker Hill, Northwest Everett, Lowell, View Ridge-Madison, Evergreen, Glacier View, Pinehurst, Silver Lake, Westmont, Boulevard Bluffs, Cascade View and Holly — plus the surrounding Snohomish County cities and down into King County.
What's the best carpet for a house with pets?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing, laid over a moisture-barrier pad. The backing and barrier keep accidents from soaking into the subfloor — that soak is what makes odor permanent — and solution-dyed fiber takes cleaning as strong as diluted bleach without losing its color. The barrier pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot, and both come in the van to compare.
What warranty comes with the install?

The installation carries a 1-year workmanship warranty from OC Flooring, and the carpet carries the mill's warranty on top — typically 10 to 25 years on wear and stain depending on grade. Both are spelled out on your written quote. One detail worth knowing: some mill warranties require a specific pad grade underneath, which is one more reason all three grades ride along to the measure.
